work.math: Slice 512 is listed at $24 a year. No monthly total is stated, and whether it is in stock and can be ordered was not confirmed.
The $3.50 a month plan covers 730 hours. It is out of stock right now.
$15 a month for the VM + 10% ($1.50) for seven nightly backups = $16.50 before tax. Stock was out when checked.
